story.title: A clinic built around the gums
paragraphs: Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic is a new dental practice on Ashramam Road in Tadepalli. It is led by Dr. Sindhu, a periodontist — a dentist who specialises in the gums and the bone that support the teeth.

Gum disease is one of the most common reasons adults lose teeth, and it often goes unnoticed because it rarely hurts in the early stages. Starting every plan with the gums means problems are caught early and other treatment rests on a healthy base.

Dr. Sindhu works alongside an oral and maxillofacial surgeon and a root canal specialist, so extractions, wisdom teeth and root canal treatment can be handled at the same clinic by the doctor trained for each.

items.title: See it for yourself
items.text: We show you what we find, using X-rays or photos where they help.

items.title: Costs before treatment
items.text: Prices are explained before any treatment starts. No surprises at the counter.

items.title: Gentle by default
items.text: Local anaesthetic is used for procedures, and you can ask to pause at any time.

items.title: Sterile every time
items.text: Instruments are sterilised between patients; disposables are used once.
